crisis_counseling.title: Immediate Crisis Support
crisis_counseling.description: What to say and do right now in a crisis situation
steps: Stay calm and speak in a gentle, reassuring voice
Validate their feelings: 'I can see how much pain you're in'
Listen without judgment - don't try to 'fix' everything
Remind them they're not alone: 'I'm here with you'
Focus on the present moment: 'Let's get through this together'
phrases: I'm here for you and I care about you
Your life matters and you are important
These feelings will pass, even if it doesn't feel like it
You are stronger than you think right now
Let's take this one moment at a time

crisis_counseling.title: Safety Planning
crisis_counseling.description: Creating immediate safety in a crisis
steps: Remove any immediate means of harm if possible
Create a safe environment (calm, quiet space)
Stay with the person - don't leave them alone
actions: Remove medications, weapons, or other harmful items

crisis_counseling.title: Validation and Hope
phrases: I understand how overwhelming this feels
Your pain is real and valid
Many people have felt this way and found hope
There are people who want to help you through this
encouragement: You've already taken a brave step by reaching out
Healing is possible, even when it seems impossible
You are not defined by this moment
Your life has value and purpose
This pain doesn't have to be permanent

crisis_counseling.title: Professional Help Guidance
steps: Explain that professionals are trained to help
Offer to help make the call
Stay with them during the call
Reassure them it's confidential and judgment-free
resources: Therapists and counselors are trained specifically for these situations
Crisis hotlines are available 24/7 with trained professionals
Emergency rooms have crisis intervention teams
Mental health professionals can provide ongoing support
Support groups connect people with similar experiences
